Given this risk, we thought we'd take a look at whether Corcel (LON:CRCL) shareholders should be worried about its cash burn. A company's cash runway is the amount of time it would take to burn through its cash reserves at its current cash burn rate. As at December 2025, Corcel had cash of UK£5.2m and such minimal debt that we can ignore it for the purposes of this analysis. In the last year, its cash burn was UK£5.9m. That means it had a cash runway of around 11 months as of December 2025. Importantly, the one analyst we see covering the stock thinks that Corcel will reach cashflow breakeven in 3 years.
